(Currently amended) The automated communications system of claim 1 wherein the routing-and-message-forwarding component determines whether or not the message is authorized to be forwarded by: parsing the destination address into an ordered sequence of nodes; and for each node of the ordered sequence of nodes, determining whether the source address is authorized to send a message to the node __by accessing one or more authorization databases to verify authorization information associated with the source address and the node__.

3. (Currently amended) The automated communications system of claim 1 wherein the routing-and-message-forwarding component determines whether or not the message is authorized to be forwarded by: parsing the destination address into an ordered sequence of nodes; and for each node of the ordered sequence of nodes, determining whether the source address is authorized to send a message to the node by finding information that authorizes the source address stored within the automated communications system, and __when the source address is authorized to send a message to the node, forwarding the message to the node, and when the source address is not authorized to send a message to the node, returning an indication of failure__.

4. (Currently amended) The automated communications system of claim 1 wherein the routing-and-message-forwarding component determines whether or not the message is authorized to be forwarded by: parsing the destination address into an ordered sequence of nodes; and for each node of the ordered sequence of nodes, determining whether the source address is authorized to send a message to the node by failing to find information that blocks messages with the source address stored within the automated communications system, and __when the source address is authorized to send a message to the node, forwarding the message to the node, and when the source address is not authorized to send a message to the node, returning an indication of failure__.

5. (Currently amended) The automated communications system of claim 1 wherein the routing-and-message-forwarding component determines whether or not the message is authorized to be forwarded by: parsing the destination address into an ordered sequence of nodes and/or node-token pairs; and for each node and/or node-token pair of the ordered sequence of nodes and/or node-token pairs, determining whether the source address is authorized to send a message to the node by failing to find information that blocks messages with the source address stored within the automated communications system, by finding information that authorizes the source address stored within the automated communications system, and/or by applying any rules that apply to the message stored within the automated communications system, and __when the source address is authorized to send a message to the node__, __accessing stored information within the automated communications system to determine whether or not __a token associated with the node-token pair__ is valid, __when the token is not valid, returning an indication of failure, and when the token is valid, forwarding the message to the node__.
